requirements.acceptance: Source, preview and split modes; independently selectable panes; pointer and keyboard resize; one canonical document; rendered pane is edited in place as rendered text and the Markdown source follows; pasted rich text converts to Markdown; #tag renders as a chip; Shift+Enter inserts a line break; formatting toolbar limited to Markdown constructs; link bubble, Cmd+K and auto-linking
GFM headings, tables, tasks and highlighted fences render; scripts/unsafe URLs stripped; external images opt-in
Native NSDocument open/save, UTF-8 BOM and CRLF format preservation; crash-recovery snapshots
Provider/model selection; live 1200ms paragraph review when configured; manual correction; original/replacement/reason; Tab accepts/Esc rejects; stale suggestions cannot apply; IME-safe
AI factual, wording and grammar review; native provider-search URL provenance; fact-labelled and numeric changes require evidence; semantic classification and relevance remain model judgments
No localhost server needed; API credentials in macOS Keychain/environment only; bundled sanitized preview; bounded review and stale-result checks
Native macOS .app with source/rendered/split view, native file editing and AI settings
Debounced durable draft autosave and original-file autosave when saved, truthful errors, conflict detection
Immutable timestamped versions with preview, restore-as-new-version and reopening recovery

Folder workspace window with file tree; ignored build folders and secret-like files hidden; Markdown opens in the source/rendered pane; other text files open in a code view with line numbers and syntax colouring; edits autosave with external-change guard

Agent run recorded as ordered steps; a step = reasoning text since the previous step + tools run + per-file before/after; changes made by shell commands are captured; parallel tool calls form one step; secret-like, ignored, oversized and non-UTF-8 files are never snapshotted

Step review: ordered timeline, reason and line diff per step, previous/next, accept marks and advances, reject restores the previous text only when the step's result is still present (whole file, or every changed hunk found exactly once); otherwise refuses and writes nothing
Typed instruction runs Claude Code headless in the workspace; follow-ups resume the same session; stop button; non-JSON output is shown, not dropped
Simple terminal: shell command runs in the workspace, output streams into the log, `cd` persists, exit status shown; agent tool activity appears in the same log
Recorded sessions persist per workspace and reload with decisions
`margin [folder|file ...]` opens folders as workspace windows and files as documents
Formatter of the open file's language runs on the editor text and is applied as one undoable saved edit; indent keys
Terminal tab on a pseudo-terminal: full-screen programs, Ctrl-C, resize, Hangul, selection, scrollback
Checks replay a recorded stream with no live AI, no Keychain and no synthetic input; a workspace scan covers at most 5000 files of at most 1 MiB each

design.rendering: native/preview.{html,js,css} with pinned marked/DOMPurify/Prism bundle resources
design.transport: native/Review.swift: URLSession providers, native search evidence and Keychain
design.persistence: native/Core.swift: VersionStore immutable snapshots; native NSDocument autosave with FileGuard conflict check

knownLimits: Live AI provider and Keychain credential storage need a configured key; not claimed as verified by fake parser tests
Model source relevance and semantic claim classification remain model judgments
Mixed EOL files normalize to the first EOL style
Versions stay local and are not automatically pruned
